description: This Java class 'BCKeyAndCertificateFactory' handles creation, loading, and management of X.509 certificates and private keys, including generating CA and leaf certificates, saving them as PEM files, and building certificate chains within a TLS context, specifically using Bouncy Castle libraries.

classes.name: BCKeyAndCertificateFactory
classes.description: A factory class for generating, loading, and managing X.509 certificates and private keys, including CA and leaf certificates, with support for dynamic updates and PEM file handling, using Bouncy Castle libraries.

methods.name: buildAndSaveCertificateAuthorityPrivateKeyAndX509Certificate
methods.description: Generates and saves the CA private key and X.509 certificate if they are not yet created and dynamic updates are enabled.

methods.name: certificateAuthorityPrivateKeyPath
methods.description: Returns the file path for the CA private key, updating configuration if dynamic creation is enabled.

methods.name: certificateAuthorityPrivateKey
methods.description: Loads the CA private key from PEM file, generating it if necessary.

methods.name: certificateAuthorityX509CertificatePath
methods.description: Returns the file path for the CA X.509 certificate, updating configuration if dynamic creation is enabled.

methods.name: certificateAuthorityX509Certificate
methods.description: Loads the CA X.509 certificate from PEM file, generating it if necessary.

methods.name: generateCACert
methods.description: Creates a self-signed CA X.509 certificate with specified algorithm and keys.

methods.name: buildAndSavePrivateKeyAndX509Certificate
methods.description: Generates and saves a leaf private key and X.509 certificate, or loads existing ones.

methods.name: privateKeyPath
methods.description: Returns the file path for the leaf private key, updating configuration.

methods.name: privateKey
methods.description: Returns the leaf private key, either from memory or PEM file.

methods.name: x509CertificatePath
methods.description: Returns the file path for the leaf X.509 certificate, updating configuration.

methods.name: x509Certificate
methods.description: Returns the leaf X.509 certificate, either from memory or PEM file.

methods.name: generateLeafCert
methods.description: Creates a signed leaf X.509 certificate with specified parameters, including SANs.

methods.name: signCertificate
methods.description: Signs a certificate builder with a private key to produce an X.509 certificate.

methods.name: createSubjectKeyIdentifier
methods.description: Creates a subject key identifier extension for a given key.

methods.name: certificateChain
methods.description: Returns the chain of certificates including the leaf and CA certificates.
